about: Turn 105 of the 2026-11-13 fog-on playthrough: the Oracle's free tech is owed. Takes Sailing, then checks that a second free tech is refused and the chooser is gone. The grant arrives as a net message a few frames after 'freetech' replies, so the check waits a second; without it a fresh launch saw Sailing and its splash where a reused client did not. The last todo ignores infoScreens: whether Sailing's splash shows depends on SAS_UI_TECH_SPLASH_ON, which ships on but the dev toggle turns off (2026-11-13).
